notes.title: Dungeon Croaker New Demo
notes.notes:
Dungeon Croaker (Formerly Penumbra Tower) has a new demo available to play right now! This new demo build completely revamps most of the major systems since the last demo back in February. These updates mainly focus on revamping the turn-based combat, new relics and upgrades, equipped weapons and a ranked leaderboard.

Demo 2 Changes:
[list]
[*] Revamped combat system
[*] New enemy multi-ability system
[*] Removed multi-action turns from enemies
[*] Updated demo boss fight
[*] Revamped relic/item system
[*] Relics can be upgraded
[*] 28 new relics
[*] New corrupted relic types
[*] Relic rarity weight
[*] Weapon + spirit system
[*] Player gains spirit on enemy kill
[*] Weapons now cost spirit to use
[*] New short sword weapon
[*] New bomb sack weapon
[*] Revamped grid generation system
[*] Tile grids are now more dynamically shaped
[*] Tile Map sprite sheet visual update for volcanic and forest environments
[*] New desert room environment
[*] Added steamworks leaderboard
[*] New floor types:
[*] New rest/upgrade room
[*] New Corrupted room
[*] Controller support added (no key-binding yet)
[*] And some other stuff i probably forgot…
[/list]

notes.title: Penumbra Tower Demo Available NOW
notes.notes:
The Demo for Penumbra Tower is now LIVE!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2600290/Penumbra_Tower/

[b]This demo includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] 30 floors
[*] 3 room environments
[*] 7 abilities to find
[*] 9 enemy types
[*] +20 items
[*] 1 boss fight
[/list]
